title: Nova Caelum framework — loop.state.json
description: T3.1 (ncf-m3-state-object). Machine-readable position for one multi-session loop run. Mirrors _agentOS/graph_library/contracts/run.py's MachineRun field-for-field where meaning matches (run_id, original_input, input_hash, status, current_node); framework_version plays machine_version's role. status uses PRD_NovaCaelumFramework_ChiefPM_2026-08-27.md #9.1's LoopStatus set, not run.py's RunStatus — the two enums diverge deliberately (see Engineer_Notes_T3.1_2026-09-06.md field-mirroring table). Validated by system/bin/loop_state.py's hand-rolled minimal draft-07 subset (required/type/enum/properties/items only) — see that file's module docstring for why.

run_id.description: Mirrors MachineRun.run_id. Stored as a string (uuid4 hex/canonical form), not validated as a UUID by the minimal validator.

goal_slug.description: The <goal-slug> in workspace/<goal-slug>/loop.state.json. Also this run's directory name.

framework_version.description: Plays MachineRun.machine_version's role for the loop (renamed per DECISIONS.md D6 — 'machine_version' names the Graph Machine specifically).

original_input.description: Mirrors MachineRun.original_input. Immutable — the raw submission, set once at init, never rewritten by later saves.

input_hash.description: Mirrors MachineRun.input_hash. sha256 hex digest of original_input, computed once at init.

status.description: PRD #9.1's LoopStatus set, verbatim. Deliberately NOT run.py's RunStatus (see Engineer_Notes field-mirroring table for the divergence).

current_node.description: Mirrors MachineRun.current_node. The stage/node identifier the run is presently in, or null before any node has been entered.

trail.description: History of node transitions, oldest first. The most recent entry has exited_at/outcome null while the run is still in that node.

artifacts.description: T3.2 (ncf-m3-artifact-freeze) fills the freeze/hash behavior; this shape is declared now, not implemented. One entry per artifact frozen at a gate pass.

gates.description: T3.1 design decision (see Engineer_Notes 'gates[] item shape' section — T3.2 inherits this shape). One entry per node whose exit gate has been evaluated.

budget.description: T3.6 (ncf-m3-budget-counters) fills the counting behavior; this shape is declared now. Four Daniel caps plus three round/retry counters.

fresh_sessions.description: T3.6 (ncf-m3-budget-counters). Daniel's cap: 1, per task. `_is_measured: false` — a provisional number, not a measured one (PRD §6.3). `_is_detected: true` — the SessionStart hook observes `source=startup` and calls `bump --event startup`.

compactions.description: T3.6 (ncf-m3-budget-counters). Daniel's cap: 1, per task. `_is_measured: false` — a provisional number, not a measured one (PRD §6.3). `_is_detected: true` — the SessionStart hook observes `source=compact` and calls `bump --event compact`.

daniel_hours.description: T3.6 (ncf-m3-budget-counters). Daniel's cap: 2 real-time hours, per task. `_is_measured: false` — a provisional number, not a measured one (PRD §6.3). `_is_detected: false` and stays false: nothing in this system observes a real-time hour elapsing, so this cap is advisory only (PRD §6.2's own rule — an undetected cap is visibly advisory, not quietly decorative) and `used` is never bumped by any code path here.

worklog_entries.description: T3.6 (ncf-m3-budget-counters). Daniel's cap: 3 worklog entries, per task. `_is_measured: false` — a provisional number, not a measured one (PRD §6.3). `_is_detected: false` and stays false: nothing in this system observes a worklog append happening, so this cap is advisory only (PRD §6.2's own rule — an undetected cap is visibly advisory, not quietly decorative) and `used` is never bumped by any code path here.

doubled_back_rounds.description: T3.2 (ncf-m3-artifact-freeze). Incremented by check_frozen() (system/bin/loop_state.py) on every frozen-artifact hash mismatch it discovers — never by an argument telling it a change happened.

doubled_back_events.description: T3.2 (ncf-m3-artifact-freeze). One entry per hash mismatch check_frozen() has ever detected, oldest first — the durable answer to 'which artifact, and when'.

driver.description: T3.6 fills behavior. Who/what was driving at the last approval.

kill.description: T3.5 (ncf-m3-kill-predicate) fills the predicate that sets this. Cause is recorded here; cause never gates (PRD #9.1).

descope_decision_ref.description: T3.5 (ncf-m3-kill-predicate). Set by the `descope` event verb (system/bin/loop_state.py); a pointer to where the descope decision is recorded, per PRD #9.3 ('the decision is recorded in loop.state.json, not remembered'). Null until a descope decision exists. Presence (not content) is what terminal_route() in loop_terminal.py consults — cause-blind by the same rule as `kill.reason`.

final_route.description: PRD #9.1's LEGITIMATE_TERMINAL set, or null before the run ends. Deliberately NOT run.py's TerminalRoute (see Engineer_Notes field-mirroring table).

escape_rate.description: PRD #6.3: recorded, never thresholded in v1. Written when work moves from finished to confirmed; null until then.
